62052.recognize_zh: 密集的小淋巴球背景中，可見許多散在的大型細胞呈淡紅色、較弱的環狀膜染色，小淋巴球均為陰性；大型細胞孤立散佈而非成片，提示為 NLPHL 中的 LP 細胞，但抗原未標示且染色強度偏弱。
features: Dense background of small round negative lymphocytes
Scattered large cells with weak-to-moderate membranous/cytoplasmic red chromogen staining
Positive cells are evenly dispersed singly without forming sheets
Large positive cells show pale vesicular nuclei
Weak staining intensity limits assessment of fine detail
62052.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled) shows numerous scattered large cells with weak-to-moderate membranous staining in a dense background of negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells are individually dispersed and do not form sheets. The staining intensity is relatively weak, limiting evaluation. In the context of the referenced case, the scattered positive large cells are consistent with LP cells of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with a variant pattern; the marker identity should be verified with the case materials.

ddx.vs: If this were CD30, strong membrane-plus-Golgi staining of HRS cells would favor cHL; LP cells are usually CD30 negative.
Separated by the absence of small-B-cell nodules and FDC meshworks, which is not assessable on this single stain.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia with scattered immunoblasts
ddx.vs: Reactive immunoblasts lack T-cell rosettes and the monotonous large-cell atypia of LP cells.

61988.recognize_zh: 六格組合圖：A、B（H&E）顯示表皮下真皮中的淋巴球浸潤，並有擴張的淋巴管腔內聚集著大型細胞；C–F 免疫染色可見管腔內細胞群被標示，C 與 F 陽性細胞較少；各格染色標記未標示，只能依標題推測為管腔內 CD30 陽性細胞。
features: A (H&E x100): skin with intact epidermis and a dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
B (H&E x200): dilated thin-walled dermal channels containing intraluminal aggregates of larger cells amid a perivascular infiltrate
C (IHC x200): sparse staining outlining vessel-like structures and scattered cells
D and E (IHC x200): numerous positive cells, including a dense intraluminal cluster within a vessel
F (IHC x200): scattered positive nuclei, fewer than in D/E
Markers are not labeled on the panels, limiting specific immunophenotypic interpretation
61988.describe_en: Composite of skin sections. H&E sections show a dermal lymphohistiocytic infiltrate beneath an intact epidermis, with dilated thin-walled channels containing intraluminal aggregates of larger mononuclear cells. The accompanying immunostains (markers not labeled) highlight positive cells within the dermis and a dense cluster within a vascular lumen, with other panels showing sparser staining. Because the markers are not identified, the lymphatic nature of the vessels (e.g., D2-40) and the CD30 status of the intraluminal cells cannot be confirmed from the image alone. Findings are compatible with intralymphatic aggregates of activated lymphoid cells, as in cutaneous intralymphatic CD30-positive pseudolymphoma, but the benign nature depends on clinical correlation, lack of a clonal T-cell population and clinical regression.

ddx.vs: Intralymphatic ALCL shows markedly atypical hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30, frequent loss of pan-T antigens and a clonal TCR rearrangement, often with a systemic or progressive course, whereas the pseudolymphoma is self-limited and usually polyclonal.
Lymphomatoid papulosis presents as recurrent self-healing papules with a wedge-shaped dermal infiltrate of CD30+ cells that is largely extravascular rather than confined to lymphatic lumens.
Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma fills capillaries and small vessels with CD20+ large B cells rather than CD30+ T cells or histiocytes in lymphatics.

61924.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片左上方有一個巨噬細胞，細胞質內吞噬了一個含粗大紫紅色顆粒的細胞；右側顆粒球系細胞的顆粒也偏粗，這種巨大粗顆粒是Chediak-Higashi症候群的線索（影像模糊，細節有限）。
features: Macrophage with abundant blue-gray cytoplasm containing a phagocytosed cell with coarse purple-red granules
Engulfed cell shows giant, coarse cytoplasmic granules/inclusions
Granulocytic precursors on the right with prominent coarse purple granules
Background erythroid precursors, mature neutrophils and red cells
Image is blurred and out of focus, limiting assessment of granule size in individual cells
61924.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant cytoplasm containing a phagocytosed cell bearing coarse purple-red granules. Nearby granulocytic precursors display prominent, coarse cytoplasmic granules, set among erythroid precursors, neutrophils and red cells. Image resolution and focus are limited, precluding detailed assessment of granule size across all cells. In the appropriate clinical context (partial oculocutaneous albinism, recurrent infections), findings are consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome, with hemophagocytosis suggesting the accelerated (HLH-like) phase.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine to moderately coarse dark granules evenly distributed in neutrophils, whereas Chediak-Higashi inclusions are giant, irregular, fused lysosomal granules present in many lineages.
Alder-Reilly shows dense dark azurophilic granules in all leukocytes without the giant fused inclusions of Chediak-Higashi, and is associated with mucopolysaccharidoses.
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules occur in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid cells with blasts or dysplasia, and are not constitutional or seen in lymphocytes.
Primary or secondary HLH shows hemophagocytosis but lacks giant granules in granulocytes and lymphocytes.

61732.recognize_zh: 骨髓 core 切片高倍可見片狀中型芽細胞，核圓形至不規則、有些有凹陷或摺痕，染色質細緻呈粉塵狀、核仁小，胞質少而淡，並有散在核分裂像；單調的芽細胞浸潤本身不具譜系特異性，需免疫染色歸類為 BPDCN。
features: Sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized blasts
Round to irregular nuclei, some indented or folded, with fine powdery chromatin
Small nucleoli in a subset of cells
Scant to moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in areas
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional apoptotic bodies
Few residual erythroid precursors; adipocyte at upper left
61732.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized blasts with round to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei, fine powdery chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are scattered, and only rare residual erythroid precursors are present. No maturing granulocytes, eosinophils or megakaryocytic dysplasia are evident in this field. Findings represent marrow replacement by a blastic neoplasm, consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when supported by CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 immunostains.

ddx.vs: AML may be morphologically identical in sections and is separated by MPO, CD34 and CD117 positivity versus CD123/TCF4/TCL1 with CD56.
Lymphoblasts show similar fine chromatin and mitoses but are TdT-positive with CD19/PAX5 or CD3 expression.
Blastoid MCL expresses CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11, which BPDCN lacks.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma or extramedullary monocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: These are lysozyme/CD68/CD163 or MPO-positive and usually CD123-dim, without TCF4 nuclear staining.

61668.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見許多大型組織球，細胞質淡粉紅、呈顆粒或泡沫狀，其中散佈微小的點狀與小泡狀構造，對應細胞內的小型酵母菌；不過此張照片中菌體輪廓不夠清楚，需以 GMS 或 PAS 染色確認組織胞漿菌。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, granular to foamy cytoplasm
Histiocyte nuclei oval to reniform with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Faint tiny dot-like and small vacuolated intracytoplasmic structures compatible with yeast forms; individual organisms are poorly resolved in this image
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and occasional granulocytes
Scattered orange-red pigment/debris; no discrete granulomas
61668.describe_en: At high power, the section shows numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale granular to foamy cytoplasm and vesicular oval nuclei, admixed with lymphocytes and occasional granulocytes. Within the histiocyte cytoplasm are faint tiny dot-like structures and small vacuoles corresponding to intracellular yeast forms, although individual organisms and their halos are not sharply resolved in this photograph. No well-formed granulomas or necrosis are seen. Findings are suggestive of a histiocytic infiltrate harbouring intracellular yeasts, consistent with histoplasmosis in context; special stains are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a distinct nucleus and bar-shaped kinetoplast and are GMS and PAS negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts are GMS positive.
HLH histiocytes contain engulfed red cells, nucleated cells and platelets rather than tiny uniform yeasts, and fungal stains are negative.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm with striations and no discrete organisms, and PAS stains the cytoplasm diffusely rather than individual yeast walls.
MAC-laden histiocytes show striated foamy cytoplasm with innumerable acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain and no budding yeast forms on GMS.

61604.recognize_zh: 大型細胞呈片狀浸潤，核卵圓、染色質泡狀、核仁明顯，部分細胞核偏位並具雙嗜色細胞質（漿細胞樣分化），可見分裂相與壓扁的深染核；這種帶漿細胞樣特徵的大細胞淋巴瘤外觀是漿母細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Sheets of large atypical cells with oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli
Subset with eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm suggesting plasmacytoid differentiation
Admixed crushed hyperchromatic nuclei and apoptotic cells; scattered mitotic figures
Thin fibrovascular septum crossing the field; no nodular architecture
Minimal background small lymphocytes
61604.describe_en: Sections show diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells traversed by a thin fibrovascular band. The neoplastic cells have oval vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli; many show eccentrically placed nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, imparting a plasmablastic appearance. Mitotic figures, apoptotic bodies and crushed hyperchromatic nuclei are present. Morphology alone does not separate this from other high-grade B-cell lymphomas, but in the context of a CD20-negative, MUM1/CD138-positive and EBER-positive immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is CD20/PAX5 positive, whereas plasmablastic lymphoma lacks pan-B markers and expresses MUM1/CD138.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic plasma cell myeloma / plasmablastic myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma is supported by marrow-based disease, M-protein and lytic lesions and is usually EBER negative.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30 with T-cell or ALK expression, not a plasma cell program.
Cohesive nests and keratin or S100/SOX10 expression exclude a hematolymphoid neoplasm that lacks CD45 and CD20.

61540.recognize_zh: 多個黃色箭頭指出的大血小板呈深紫色顆粒狀、直徑約紅血球的三分之一到一半，明顯比周圍一般血小板大；左下有一顆小淋巴球可作大小對照。
features: Multiple large platelets (yellow arrows) about one-third to one-half the diameter of a red cell with dense purple granules
Numerous normal-sized platelets and small platelet clumps between and over red cells
Small mature lymphocyte at lower left serving as a size reference
Red cells normochromic with focal crenation; occasional pale ghost-like cells
No schistocytes or red cell inclusions evident
61540.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with focal crenation and abundant platelets, including numerous normal-sized forms and small aggregates. Several large platelets (yellow arrows), measuring approximately one-third to one-half of a red cell diameter, are distributed throughout the field. A small mature lymphocyte is present at lower left. Findings demonstrate increased large platelets with an adequate platelet estimate, supporting spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counting.

ddx.dx: Red cell inclusions (e.g. Pappenheimer bodies or parasites) overlying red cells
ddx.vs: True inclusions lie within the red cell outline, whereas these platelets sit between or on top of red cells with their own pale hyalomere.
Stain precipitate forms irregular refractile dark granules of varying size across cells and background, without the organized granulomere/hyalomere structure of a platelet.
These cause large platelets with a truly low count and require leukocyte inclusion review, flow cytometry for GPIb-IX or genetic testing.

61476.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 中可見多顆大型細胞，細胞質淡染並因固定收縮而與周圍組織分離，形成透明空腔（lacunar cell），核呈分葉狀或處於分裂期，並有一小群嗜酸性白血球，符合結節硬化型典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤。
features: Large cells with abundant clear, finely vacuolated cytoplasm retracted from surrounding cells, forming lacunar spaces
Lacunar cell nuclei are lobated or folded with vesicular chromatin and small-to-moderate nucleoli; one cell in mitosis
Small aggregate of eosinophils with bilobed nuclei in the upper center
Dense background of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei and thin collagen strands
Cluster of clear lacunar-like cells at the lower edge
61476.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a dense lymphoid background containing numerous large cells with abundant clear, retracted cytoplasm that sit within empty lacunar spaces. Their nuclei are lobated or folded with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, and one lacunar cell is in mitosis. A small aggregate of eosinophils and thin collagen strands are present. Findings are consistent with lacunar variant Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype, pending CD30/CD15/PAX5 immunohistochemistry and assessment of fibrous bands at low power.

ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells form cohesive sheets or sinusoidal clusters with horseshoe nuclei and are CD30+ with T-cell markers/ALK, not scattered lacunar cells.
PMBL cells also have clear cytoplasm with compartmentalizing sclerosis but grow in sheets and are strongly CD20/CD79a and CD45 positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic clear cell carcinoma or germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: Carcinoma and seminoma form cohesive nests and are keratin or OCT4/SALL4 positive, whereas lacunar cells are CD30/CD15 positive and keratin negative.

ddx.dx: Signet ring cell lymphoma or histiocytes
ddx.vs: Clear histiocytes have small bland nuclei and are CD68/CD163 positive, lacking large lobated nuclei with nucleoli.

61412.recognize_zh: IRF4 分離探針（break-apart）螢光原位雜交中，多個腫瘤細胞核（藍色 DAPI）內的紅色與綠色訊號彼此分開（黃色與綠色箭頭標示），而非正常的紅綠融合訊號，代表 IRF4 基因重組。
features: Interphase FISH on tissue section with DAPI-counterstained (blue) nuclei of tumor cells
IRF4 break-apart probe: arrows mark red (yellow arrows) and green (green arrows) signals separated from each other within individual nuclei
Separated signals indicate disruption of the IRF4 locus (rearrangement); some nuclei show an isolated green signal without a matching red
Overlapping nuclei and truncation from tissue sectioning limit complete signal counts; a few autofluorescent cells (bright yellow-white) are present
61412.describe_en: Fluorescence in situ hybridization with an IRF4 break-apart probe on tissue sections shows multiple tumor nuclei with split red and green signals, indicated by paired yellow and green arrows, rather than a single fused signal per allele. Several nuclei show an isolated green signal, consistent with the reported pattern of one fusion and one green signal with loss of the telomeric red signal. Signal enumeration is limited by nuclear overlap and truncation in tissue sections. Findings indicate IRF4 rearrangement, supporting large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: A normal cell shows two fused (yellow or adjacent red-green) signals, without widely separated or isolated single-color signals.
Isolated single signals from nuclear sectioning occur at low frequency in controls, so a rearrangement call requires exceeding the laboratory cutoff over many scored nuclei.

ddx.dx: IGH-IRF4 fusion with other partners / DUSP22-IRF4 (6p25) rearrangement in ALCL
ddx.vs: IRF4 break-apart probes also detect DUSP22 region breaks in ALK-negative ALCL, so morphology and B-cell immunophenotype are needed to interpret the result.

61348.recognize_zh: 畫面中央的大型細胞周圍有一圈透明的空隙（retraction lacuna），細胞內有摺疊或重疊的核葉及明顯核仁，周邊為密集的小淋巴球，這就是結節硬化型古典何杰金淋巴瘤的陷窩細胞（lacunar cell）。
features: Large cell surrounded by a clear retraction space (lacuna)
Overlapping, folded nuclear lobes with a distinct eosinophilic to amphophilic nucleolus
Delicate, wispy cytoplasm retracted toward the nucleus
Adjacent large mononuclear cell with vesicular chromatin
Dense background of small lymphocytes with scattered histiocytes
61348.describe_en: High-power section shows a large atypical cell residing within a clear retraction space, with overlapping lobated nuclei, a distinct nucleolus, and wispy cytoplasm drawn toward the nucleus. A second large mononuclear cell with vesicular chromatin is nearby. The background consists of numerous small lymphocytes with occasional histiocytes. These findings are consistent with the lacunar variant of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, as seen in nodular sclerosis classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation with CD30, CD15, and weak PAX5 is recommended.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei expressing strong CD30, EMA and T-cell antigens, rather than scattered lacunar cells in a lymphocyte-rich background.
LP cells have popcorn nuclei with small nucleoli and are CD20+/CD30-, lacking retraction lacunae.
PMBL shows sheets of large B cells with clear cytoplasm and compartmentalizing fibrosis and strong CD20/CD79a, not isolated HRS cells.

61284.recognize_zh: 以視野中央的小淋巴球核作為尺規：正常紅血球約與小淋巴球核同大，此處紅血球明顯比淋巴球核小，且大小相當一致，即小球性紅血球（microcytosis）；紅血球邊緣呈鋸齒狀屬製片乾燥假影。
features: Red cells uniformly smaller than the nucleus of the central small lymphocyte (normal RBC diameter approximates a small lymphocyte nucleus)
Relatively uniform red cell size with little anisocytosis in this field
Diffuse fine crenation of red cells (drying/storage artifact), obscuring central pallor
Scattered platelets and small platelet aggregates; occasional smudged or lysed cell ghosts at the periphery
No target cells, basophilic stippling or nucleated red cells clearly identified at this magnification
61284.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monolayer of red cells that are distinctly smaller than the nucleus of a small lymphocyte in the center of the field, indicating microcytosis. The red cells are fairly uniform in size and show diffuse crenation, which is an artifact and limits assessment of central pallor and hypochromia. Platelets are present with small aggregates. No target cells or basophilic stippling are evident at this power. Findings are consistent with microcytosis (reported MCV 57.1 fL); correlation with red cell count, RDW and iron studies is needed to separate thalassemia trait from iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Typically shows marked anisocytosis, pencil cells and pronounced hypochromia with a high RDW and low red cell count, whereas a uniform microcytic population with a high red cell count favors thalassemia trait.
Shows microcytosis with erythrocytosis, target cells and sometimes basophilic stippling; confirmed by hemoglobin electrophoresis (HbA2) or alpha-globin gene testing.
Usually normocytic or only mildly microcytic (MCV rarely below 70 fL) with high ferritin.
Spherocytes are small but dense and lack central pallor with an elevated MCHC, whereas true microcytes here have a low MCV.

61156.recognize_zh: 低倍視野下絕大多數紅血球呈橢圓形到雪茄形，方向隨機排列，細胞大小大致一致、中央淡染區仍保留，另可見少量碎片與不規則形紅血球，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症（hereditary elliptocytosis）。
features: Majority of red cells are oval to elongated elliptocytes, some cigar-shaped
Elliptocytes are roughly normocytic with preserved central pallor
Scattered small fragmented and irregular poikilocytes
Elliptocytes randomly oriented across the field (not an artifactual unidirectional streak)
Platelets present; no nucleated cells or parasites evident at this magnification
61156.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a markedly increased proportion of elliptocytes, which dominate the red cell population and are randomly oriented throughout the monolayer. Most elliptocytes are normocytic with retained central pallor, and a small number of fragmented and irregular poikilocytes are present. Platelets are seen; no leukocyte abnormality can be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with pencil cells in a minority of cells, not a uniform population of normochromic elliptocytes.
HPP shows marked microspherocytes, budding and severe fragmentation with very low MCV, far more poikilocytosis than seen here.
SAO cells are stomatocytic macro-ovalocytes with one or two transverse slits or bars rather than thin elliptocytes with central pallor.
Acquired elliptocytosis is usually accompanied by macro-ovalocytes, anisocytosis and dysplastic or hypersegmented leukocytes.

61092.recognize_zh: 治療前為具杯狀核凹（cup-like）的芽細胞且流式 CD34 為 0.0%，Sanger 定序顯示 IDH2 p.Arg140Gln 突變；治療期間抹片出現大量正在成熟的骨髓系細胞與分葉嗜中性球，表格追蹤芽細胞比例與突變 VAF 變化，符合標靶藥物誘導的分化而非化療緩解。
features: Pre-treatment blasts (A): large cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and nuclear invaginations giving cup-like morphology
Flow cytometry (B): blast population CD34 negative (0.0%), a pattern typical of NPM1-mutated AML
Early treatment (C): intermediate cells with more cytoplasm, folded nuclei and emerging granulation (promyelocyte/myelocyte-like)
Sanger trace (D): IDH2 c.419G>A (CGG>CAG) p.Arg140Gln
Later treatment (E): abundant maturing granulocytes including bands and segmented neutrophils
Table (F): serial marrow cellularity, blast %, mutation VAFs and blood counts over weeks of treatment (values largely illegible at this resolution)
61092.describe_en: Serial specimens document a CD34-negative AML with cup-like blast nuclei and an IDH2 R140Q mutation. During targeted therapy, smears show progressive maturation of the leukemic population, with intermediate forms and then abundant segmented neutrophils, while the accompanying table tracks blast percentages, mutant allele fractions and blood counts over time (small print limits reading of exact values). The morphology of maturing cells in the presence of the clonal mutation is the key point. Findings are consistent with IDH inhibitor–induced differentiation of AML blasts (NPM1/IDH2-mutated AML), which can be accompanied clinically by differentiation syndrome.

ddx.vs: Chemotherapy remission shows regeneration from a normal hematopoietic pool with clearance of the mutant allele, whereas differentiation therapy yields mature cells still carrying high mutant VAF.
APL differentiation begins with hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rods and PML::RARA, not cup-like CD34-negative blasts with IDH2 mutation.
A reactive left shift lacks a preceding blast population and the clonal IDH2/NPM1 mutations in the maturing cells.

61028.recognize_zh: 視野中許多紅血球的血紅素濃縮偏向細胞一側，另一側只剩透明、輪廓仍在的空膜，呈「半邊鬼影」外觀（hemighost / blister cell），是氧化性溶血（如 G6PD 缺乏者使用 rasburicase）的線索。
features: Numerous red cells with hemoglobin condensed into one half of the cell and a sharply demarcated, pale, empty membrane remnant on the other side (hemighosts)
Some cells show irregular, crenated outlines of the hemoglobin-free portion (blister-like)
Admixed spherocyte-like dense small red cells and occasional ovalocytes/target-like cells
Scattered fine dark dots in the background and on some cells, likely precipitate/artifact
Occasional small platelets; no leukocytes in the field
61028.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous hemighost (eccentrocyte/blister-type) red cells in which hemoglobin is retracted to one side of the cell, leaving a sharply demarcated, colorless membrane-bound space on the opposite side. Dense, spherocyte-like cells and mild poikilocytosis are also present. No leukocytes are included in this field. In the clinical setting of rasburicase administration, these findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, and G6PD deficiency should be excluded; a supravital stain for Heinz bodies may be supportive.

ddx.vs: Bite cells have a peripheral notch where Heinz bodies were removed by splenic macrophages, rather than a retained colorless membrane half.
Spherocytes are uniformly dense, small cells without an eccentric hemoglobin-free zone, and DAT is usually positive.
Artifactual clear areas are irregular, refractile and vary with focus, whereas hemighosts have a crisp membrane outline around a truly empty space.
Stomatocytes have a central slit-like pallor, not a hemoglobin-free half of the cell.

60900.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片左側一大片擠壓密集的細胞呈強而瀰漫的 CD99 膜／細胞質陽性，與右側含脂肪、染色較弱且不均的正常造血組織形成清楚分界，符合尤文氏肉瘤（Ewing sarcoma）骨髓轉移；CD99 不具特異性，須搭配其他標記。
features: Sharply demarcated focus of densely packed cells with strong, diffuse CD99 staining at left
Tumor area appears crushed/streaming, obscuring individual cell detail
Adjacent residual hematopoietic marrow with fat spaces shows weaker, patchy staining of scattered cells
Small bone fragments stained blue by counterstain
60900.describe_en: CD99 immunostain of the staging bone marrow core biopsy shows a sharply demarcated focus of densely packed, partly crushed cells with strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic CD99 positivity. The adjacent residual marrow with fat spaces shows only weaker, patchy staining of scattered hematopoietic cells. In a patient with known Ewing sarcoma, the strongly positive focus is consistent with metastatic Ewing sarcoma; confirmation with NKX2.2 immunostain and/or EWSR1 rearrangement is advisable, since CD99 is not specific.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are also CD99 positive with similar morphology but express TdT and CD19/PAX5 or CD3, while Ewing sarcoma is TdT and CD45 negative and NKX2.2 positive.
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with neuropil, is CD99 negative and PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin and myogenin positive, with CD99 usually weak or focal.
Myeloid blasts may express CD99 but are also MPO, CD34, CD117 and CD45 positive.

60836.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆細長彎曲、兩端尖銳、完全充滿血紅素的鐮刀細胞（sickle cell），下方另有一顆血紅素收縮至一側、旁邊留有透明膜的不規則收縮紅血球。
features: Single elongated, curved, crescent-shaped red cell with sharply pointed ends and dense hemoglobin (sickle cell)
Nearby irregularly contracted red cell with hemoglobin condensed to one side and a faint clear membrane remnant
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; occasional target-like cells
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells or leukocytes in field
60836.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional target-like forms. A single classic sickle cell is present, elongated and crescentic with tapering pointed ends, together with an irregularly contracted red cell showing hemoglobin retracted to one side and a pale membrane remnant. Sickle cells are rare in this field. Findings are suggestive of a sickling disorder (e.g., compound heterozygous or treated sickle cell disease); confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: Elliptocytes are symmetric oval cells with rounded blunt ends and retained central pallor, not crescentic with pointed tips.
HbC crystals are straight-edged rectangular condensations within an empty cell rather than a curved fully hemoglobinized crescent.
Schistocytes are small irregular fragments with sharp angles or helmet shapes and are smaller than intact cells, whereas a sickle cell is elongated and full length.

60772.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見一個大型次級淋巴濾泡，生發中心內有混合大小的中心細胞與中心母細胞、淡染的組織球，外圍被一圈完整清楚的暗色被套層包住，屬於反應性濾泡增生；IgG4 漿細胞增加須靠免疫染色才看得出來。
features: Large secondary lymphoid follicle with an expanded, mixed germinal center
Germinal center contains mixed small and large lymphoid cells with scattered pale tingible body macrophages and small vessels
Well-preserved, sharply demarcated mantle cuff of small dark lymphocytes surrounding the germinal center
Interfollicular zone with small lymphocytes and high endothelial venules
Plasma cells cannot be reliably identified or counted at this low magnification
60772.describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows a large secondary follicle with an expanded germinal center containing a mixed population of centrocytes, centroblasts and tingible body macrophages, surrounded by a well-preserved, sharply defined mantle zone of small lymphocytes. The interfollicular area contains small lymphocytes and high endothelial venules without atypical infiltrates. Plasma cells are not assessable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with reactive follicular hyperplasia; the increase in IgG4-positive plasma cells is demonstrated on the companion IgG4 immunostain.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are crowded and back-to-back with attenuated mantles, lack polarization and tingible body macrophages, and are BCL2 positive in germinal centers.
Follicles are much larger with mantle lymphocytes infiltrating and breaking up the germinal center, unlike this intact germinal center with a sharp mantle.
Nodules are large, vaguely defined and composed of small B cells with scattered LP (popcorn) cells rather than a polarized germinal center with a distinct mantle.
Follicles are regressed with depleted germinal centers, penetrating hyalinized vessels and onion-skin mantles, the opposite of this hyperplastic germinal center.

60580.recognize_zh: 周邊血液紅血球內有細小的環狀或點狀嗜鹼性寄生蟲，部分紅血球含多個小環，另可見成對或成簇的紅血球外寄生蟲，沒有瘧原蟲的色素或配子體，指向焦蟲（Babesia）；但本圖解析度有限，四聯體（Maltese cross）不明顯。
features: Red cells containing small, delicate ring-form and dot-like basophilic intraerythrocytic parasites
Occasional red cells with more than one small ring; paired/clustered organisms seen outside red cells (panel B)
No hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes identified
Reactive lymphocyte in panel A; platelets appear reduced
Low resolution and greenish color cast limit detailed assessment; classic tetrads not clearly seen
60580.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered erythrocytes containing tiny ring-shaped and punctate basophilic intracellular parasites, occasionally multiple within a single cell, as well as small paired extracellular forms. No malarial pigment, schizonts or gametocytes are identified, and platelets appear decreased. Image resolution precludes reliable identification of tetrad (Maltese cross) forms. In a patient with anemia and thrombocytopenia, findings are suggestive of babesiosis; parasitemia should be quantified and confirmed by PCR, with distinction from Plasmodium falciparum.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum shows appliqué forms, double chromatin dots, banana-shaped gametocytes and hemozoin pigment, and extracellular organisms are not seen.
Overlying platelets have a halo, are granular and lie in a different focal plane rather than being delicate rings within the red cell.
These are solid dense dots (single, or clustered peripheral iron granules) without the ring-shaped cytoplasm and chromatin of a parasite.
Stain deposits are refractile, scattered on and between cells and vary in focal plane rather than forming consistent intracellular rings.

60644.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中成群的嗜中性球，細胞內外可見染成紅色的短桿菌，部分菌體兩端較深、中央較淡，呈雙極染色（安全別針樣），提示格蘭氏陰性桿菌腦膜炎。
features: Cluster of neutrophils with segmented nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm (neutrophilic pleocytosis)
Short, straight, red-staining (gram-negative) bacilli, both intracellular within neutrophils and extracellular
Several bacilli with darker staining at the poles and a paler center (bipolar or 'safety-pin' staining)
Background proteinaceous material with no red cells; monochrome red counterstain limits nuclear detail
60644.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged cerebrospinal fluid stained with a Gram-type stain shows a cluster of neutrophils. Short gram-negative bacilli are present within the cytoplasm of several neutrophils and extracellularly, and some display accentuated staining at both ends with central clearing (bipolar staining). No yeast or gram-positive organisms are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute bacterial meningitis due to a gram-negative bacillus with bipolar staining (e.g., Yersinia, Pasteurella, Burkholderia, Enterobacterales); culture is required for identification.

ddx.vs: H. influenzae are tiny pleomorphic coccobacilli rather than distinct rods with polar condensation.
Meningococci are gram-negative kidney-shaped diplococci, whereas these organisms are elongated bacilli.
Listeria are short gram-positive (purple) rods that may be decolorized but are typically sparse and often in a mononuclear-predominant fluid.
Precipitate is irregular in size and refractile, whereas bacteria are uniform rods of consistent width, many located within phagocytes.

60708.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有成群的漿細胞，核偏一側、細胞質豐富深藍並有核旁淡染區，部分為雙核；切片中漿細胞間質性浸潤，一系列免疫染色呈現不同比例的陽性，需以 IgG4 等染色證實為 IgG4 陽性漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A: cluster of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face to slightly open chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Panel A: occasional binucleated plasma cells; scattered neutrophils
Panel B: hypocellular-to-normocellular core with interstitial infiltrate of cells with eccentric nuclei among fat
Panels C-E: immunostains (markers unlabeled) highlighting an interstitial plasma cell population with membranous/cytoplasmic staining
Panel F: one immunostain essentially negative in the infiltrate (unlabeled; likely the non-restricted light chain or another IgG subclass)
60708.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows increased plasma cells, including clusters and binucleated forms, with abundant basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei. The core biopsy shows an interstitial plasma cell infiltrate, and a panel of immunostains (markers not labeled in the figure) highlights the plasma cells with one stain negative. In context, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma expressing the IgG4 subclass; clonality should be confirmed with kappa/lambda staining, and IgG4-related disease must be excluded because it contains polytypic, not monotypic, IgG4-positive plasma cells.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD plasma cells are polytypic, accompanied by fibrosis and eosinophils, and lack light chain restriction and myeloma-defining events.
Reactive plasma cells are perivascular, polytypic and mature without clusters or light chain restriction.
LPL contains a CD20+ B-cell component and IgM paraprotein rather than a pure clonal IgG plasma cell population.

60516.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球比周圍紅血球大，核圓而染色質濃縮，最重要的是有豐富淡藍色細胞質，內含數顆散在的粗大嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Cell larger than a resting lymphocyte (roughly 1.5-2 red cell diameters)
Low to moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nucleus with coarse, condensed chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Several coarse, discrete azurophilic granules clustered in the cytoplasm
Normal-appearing background red cells
60516.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single lymphocyte that is larger than a resting lymphocyte, with a round to slightly indented nucleus, coarse condensed chromatin and no visible nucleolus. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale blue and contains scattered coarse azurophilic granules. Background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte (cytotoxic T or NK cell); persistent LGL counts above 2 x 10^9/L would warrant flow cytometry and TCR/STAT3 studies for T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and often open chromatin, and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Monocytes are larger with folded, lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles rather than a few coarse granules.
Granulocyte precursors have more numerous primary or secondary granules, a paranuclear hof and less condensed chromatin with nucleoli in promyelocytes.
Individual LGLs look identical, so neoplasia requires sustained LGL lymphocytosis with clonal TCR rearrangement and aberrant phenotype (e.g. CD5/CD7 loss).

60452.recognize_zh: 細胞密集的抹片中，顆粒球系明顯佔多數，視野中央多顆成熟嗜中性球的核分成 4–5 個小而圓、彼此分離的核葉，僅以細絲相連，部分細胞質帶細小空泡；前驅細胞（前髓細胞、髓細胞）仍在但成熟型居多，符合骨髓滯留症（myelokathexis）。
features: Cellular aspirate with granulocytic predominance and full maturation, weighted toward mature neutrophils
Central neutrophils with hypersegmented nuclei composed of 4-5 small, round, condensed, separated lobes joined by thin filaments
Subtle cytoplasmic vacuolation in some mature neutrophils
Admixed promyelocytes/myelocytes with pink granules, metamyelocytes and bands; one eosinophil (center)
Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes; no increase in blasts
60452.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows granulocytic predominance with complete maturation. Numerous mature neutrophils, best seen in the center of the field, have hyperlobated nuclei composed of small, round, dense lobes separated from one another and connected by thin chromatin filaments, with focal cytoplasmic vacuolation. Promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, an eosinophil, scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are also present, and blasts are not increased. Given peripheral neutropenia with warts, hypogammaglobulinemia and infections, these findings are consistent with myelokathexis in WHIM syndrome.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic marrow shows giant metamyelocytes/bands and megaloblastic erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, while here precursors are normoblastic and the abnormality is pyknotic filament-joined lobes.
MDS favors hypolobated pseudo-Pelger and hypogranular neutrophils with multilineage dysplasia, not uniform hypersegmented separated lobes with normal granulation.
G-CSF causes left-shifted hyperplasia with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies rather than apoptotic-appearing, filament-joined neutrophil nuclei.

60388.recognize_zh: CD3 染色中只有約一半的小淋巴球呈強烈膜陽性，其間夾雜大量藍色陰性的小細胞；與幾乎整片陽性的 CD5 相比，CD3 只標出 T 細胞，而 CD3 陰性、CD5 陽性的那群小細胞就是表現異常 CD5 的 CLL/SLL 腫瘤性 B 細胞。
features: CD3 IHC with strong membranous staining of numerous small T lymphocytes
Positive cells distributed in a patchy, interstitial pattern rather than a continuous sheet
Many intervening small lymphocytes CD3-negative (blue nuclei), representing the neoplastic B cells
No large atypical cells stained
Fewer positive cells than on the corresponding CD5 stain
60388.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous staining of numerous small T lymphocytes arranged in an interstitial, patchy pattern, with many intervening small lymphoid cells that are negative. Compared with the diffuse CD5 staining in the same area, CD3 highlights a smaller population, indicating that the CD3-negative small cells co-express CD5 aberrantly. Large cells are not highlighted. The CD5-positive/CD3-negative small B-cell population is consistent with small lymphocytic lymphoma, with a prominent background of reactive T cells in this Hodgkin-type Richter transformation case.

ddx.vs: A T-cell neoplasm would show CD3 staining of most of the infiltrate equivalent to CD5, not a CD3-negative majority of small cells.
MCL also shows CD5+/CD3- small B cells, so cyclin D1, SOX11, CD23 and LEF1 are required to separate it from CLL/SLL.
Reactive nodes show CD3-positive T cells in expanded paracortex with preserved CD5-negative follicles, rather than intermingled CD5-positive neoplastic B cells.

60132.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片細胞密度接近100%，左上與右側布滿紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞，中央則是一團呈漩渦狀排列、伴隨纖維化的紡錘形細胞聚集（紡錘形肥大細胞），右下近骨小樑處有數顆巨核細胞，符合PDGFRA重排腫瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow approaching 100% cellularity
Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Central whorled/streaming aggregate of spindle-shaped cells with associated collagenous fibrosis, consistent with spindled mast cells
Eosinophils and lymphocytes intermixed at the periphery of the spindle cell aggregate
Several megakaryocytes in the lower right near the bony trabecula; no fat seen
60132.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow approaching 100% cellularity with a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophil precursors. There is a focal, loosely whorled aggregate of spindle-shaped cells with associated fibrosis, admixed with eosinophils, morphologically consistent with a spindled mast cell infiltrate. Megakaryocytes are present in the residual hematopoietic marrow near the trabecula. Mast cell tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains and molecular testing for FIP1L1::PDGFRA are recommended. The findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.vs: SM aggregates are usually compact and sharply demarcated with KIT D816V, while PDGFRA neoplasms have looser spindled infiltrates, more striking eosinophilia and FIP1L1::PDGFRA.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with FGFR1 or PDGFRB rearrangement
ddx.vs: These share eosinophilia but are separated by cytogenetics/FISH; FGFR1 cases often present with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma or AML, and PDGFRB cases often with monocytosis.
PMF fibrosis is associated with clusters of atypical megakaryocytes and lacks marked eosinophilia and spindled tryptase-positive cells.
Hodgkin involvement shows fibrosis with a mixed infiltrate containing CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rather than tryptase-positive spindle cells.

60196.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現一個大型母細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻均勻、可見多個淡染核仁，細胞質少量偏藍且無顆粒，代表循環母細胞，符合由 MDS 進展之急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Single large circulating blast, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with round nucleus molded against adjacent red cells
Finely dispersed, open chromatin with multiple pale nucleoli
Scant rim of agranular blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional stomatocyte/target-like forms
60196.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large circulating blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, several pale nucleoli and a scant rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. In a patient with prior MDS with excess blasts and 26% circulating blasts, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts tend to be smaller with less conspicuous nucleoli, and lineage requires flow cytometry since this blast lacks granules or Auer rods.
Reactive lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, without fine blastic chromatin.
Lymphoma cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei and coarser chromatin, with a mature B- or T-cell phenotype on flow.

60068.recognize_zh: 鐵染色中，許多紅色核的紅血球系前驅細胞核周圍有多顆藍色鐵顆粒，數顆細胞（如右下成群的母紅血球）顆粒環繞核周三分之一以上，形成環狀鐵粒母細胞；背景紅血球大小形狀差異大，符合鐵粒母細胞性貧血。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors with small round nuclei highlighted by nuclear fast red
Blue siderotic granules in a perinuclear arrangement, encircling one-third or more of the nucleus in several cells (ring sideroblasts)
Clusters of adjacent ringed erythroid precursors in the lower right field
Other precursors with fewer scattered granules; larger myeloid cells lack iron
Background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with elongated and teardrop forms
60068.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue (nuclear fast red counterstain) shows numerous erythroid precursors containing blue iron granules. In a substantial proportion of precursors the granules are coarse and arranged in a perinuclear distribution encircling at least one-third of the nucleus, satisfying criteria for ring sideroblasts, while other precursors show only scattered granules; larger myeloid precursors are iron-negative. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with increased ring sideroblasts, supporting sideroblastic anemia in this clinical context.

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 mutation
ddx.vs: Iron stain appearance is the same; separated by age, dysplasia in other lineages, and SF3B1 mutation rather than germline ALAS2 or SLC25A38 variants.

ddx.dx: Toxic/nutritional sideroblastosis (alcohol, copper deficiency, isoniazid, lead)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical ring sideroblasts; diagnosed by exposure history and laboratory testing and reverses after removing the cause.
Normal or iron-overloaded sideroblasts contain granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm without a perinuclear collar.

29476.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿數十個小型卵圓形菌體，每個都有一個圓形核與一個棒狀小點（kinetoplast），部分散在細胞外，這就是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishmania amastigotes）。
features: Macrophage with abundant cytoplasm packed with numerous small (2-4 micron) oval intracellular organisms
Each organism has a round purple nucleus and a smaller adjacent rod-shaped kinetoplast
Some organisms free in the background from ruptured macrophages
Surrounding marrow precursors including plasma cells, erythroid precursors and granulocytes
No capsule or halo around organisms
29476.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous small oval intracellular organisms, each containing a round nucleus and a separate rod-shaped kinetoplast, with a few extracellular forms nearby. The background includes erythroid precursors, plasma cells and granulocytic cells. These features are diagnostic of Leishmania amastigotes. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis involving the marrow, an important cause of pancytopenia after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation; PCR and serology can support speciation and monitoring.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts lack a kinetoplast, show a clear pseudocapsular halo and narrow-based budding, and stain with GMS/PAS.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a central transverse septum and are GMS positive, without a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single central nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Platelets and nuclear debris are irregular granular fragments without the paired nucleus-kinetoplast structure.

28452.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞胞質內含多個圓形酵母菌，每個中央有深染的小菌體、外圍環繞一圈寬的透明暈（莢膜），呈泡泡狀排列，這種「帶透明莢膜的酵母菌」即新型隱球菌（Cryptococcus），病人為骨髓瘤免疫低下者。
features: Macrophage with a round nucleus and abundant pale, finely vacuolated blue cytoplasm
Numerous round-to-oval intracellular and adjacent yeast forms, each with a small dark-staining central body surrounded by a wide clear halo (capsule)
Organisms of variable size packed in a bubbly cluster, some appearing elongated or crescent-shaped due to shrinkage within the capsule
Background of crenated red cells; no hyphae or pseudohyphae
28452.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing and surrounded by numerous round yeast forms of variable size, each with a small, dark, often crescent-shaped central body and a thick clear halo corresponding to a polysaccharide capsule. No hyphae are seen. Findings are consistent with disseminated cryptococcosis involving the bone marrow; confirmation by mucicarmine or India ink staining, serum/CSF cryptococcal antigen and culture is recommended, given the neurological symptoms.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 µm) and uniform within macrophages with a thin pseudocapsule artifact and lack a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Candida shows small budding yeasts with pseudohyphae and no capsular halo.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a central transverse septum dividing by fission rather than budding, and lack a wide capsule.
Empty vacuoles lack a central staining organism and do not stain with mucicarmine, GMS or PAS.

23524.recognize_zh: 體腔積液抹片中為大型、形態像免疫母細胞/漿母細胞的腫瘤細胞，核大、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富且嗜鹼性；免疫染色 HHV-8（LANA-1）呈核內強陽性，插圖 EBER 原位雜交為陰性，符合 HHV-8 陽性、EBV 陰性的原發性積液淋巴瘤。
features: Large discohesive neoplastic cells with round to irregular nuclei and prominent nucleoli (immunoblastic/plasmablastic appearance)
Moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof
Occasional multinucleated or bizarre cells; apoptotic bodies and neutrophils in the background
IHC for HHV-8 LANA-1 shows diffuse speckled nuclear positivity in nearly all tumor cells
EBER in situ hybridization (inset) negative in tumor cell nuclei
23524.describe_en: Effusion cytology shows a cellular specimen composed of large discohesive neoplastic cells with round to irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, with scattered apoptotic debris. Immunohistochemistry for HHV-8 latency-associated nuclear antigen (LANA-1) shows diffuse nuclear positivity in the tumor cells. EBER in situ hybridization is negative. Findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma, HHV-8-positive and EBV-negative, an uncommon variant typically seen in elderly HIV-negative patients from HHV-8-endemic regions.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with secondary effusion
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells usually express CD20/CD79a and are HHV-8 negative, whereas PEL is CD20-negative with HHV-8 LANA-1 nuclear positivity.

ddx.dx: Fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma (HHV-8-negative effusion-based lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar but, by definition, HHV-8 LANA-1 negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or mesothelioma in effusion
ddx.vs: Epithelial and mesothelial cells form cohesive clusters and are keratin/calretinin positive and negative for HHV-8 and CD45/CD138.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: These are HHV-8 negative (plasmablastic lymphoma often EBER positive) and usually present as a mass or marrow disease rather than a body-cavity effusion.

23524.stain: Giemsa-type; IHC: HHV-8 LANA-1; ISH: EBER

15204.recognize_zh: 老年病人背部、雙上肢到臀部的皮膚呈瀰漫性、融合的鮮紅色紅皮症（erythroderma），幾乎無正常皮膚間隔，皮膚鬆弛有細紋，這種全身紅皮症是 Sézary 症候群的典型臨床表現。
features: Clinical photograph of the posterior trunk, arms and buttocks of an elderly patient
Diffuse, confluent bright red to violaceous erythema involving nearly the entire visible body surface (>80% BSA)
No discrete patches, plaques or tumors; the erythema is uniform with little spared skin
Skin appears thin and finely wrinkled with fine scaling over the lower back
Relative accentuation of color in skin folds and dependent areas
15204.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows an elderly patient with generalized, confluent erythema involving the back, both arms and the buttocks, with virtually no uninvolved skin. The skin is diffusely red with fine scaling and wrinkling, and there are no discrete plaques, tumors or ulceration. Palmoplantar keratoderma, lymphadenopathy and alopecia cannot be assessed in this view. Erythroderma is nonspecific; in conjunction with a clonal circulating T-cell population (Sézary count ≥1000/µL, or CD4:CD8 ≥10, or loss of CD7/CD26), findings are consistent with Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Erythrodermic MF has the same skin appearance but lacks the B2 level of blood involvement required for Sézary syndrome.
Eczematous erythroderma has polyclonal T cells, spongiosis on biopsy and a history of atopy, without a circulating CD4+CD26− clone.
Psoriatic erythroderma shows a history of psoriatic plaques, nail pitting and psoriasiform hyperplasia with parakeratosis and neutrophils in the stratum corneum.
Drug erythroderma follows medication exposure with facial edema, eosinophilia and organ involvement, and resolves on drug withdrawal.

15140.recognize_zh: A 圖淋巴結中 HHV8 LANA 核染色陽性的大細胞主要分布在濾泡外套區（mantle zone）呈環狀；B、D 圖細胞質強陽性的漿母細胞/漿細胞大量分布於外套區與濾泡間，C 圖另一輕鏈染色僅呈淡背景染色，提示 HIV 相關多中心 Castleman 病的漿母細胞呈 lambda 輕鏈表現。
features: A: nuclear stippled positivity (consistent with HHV8 LANA-1) in scattered large cells concentrated in the mantle zone around a regressed follicle
B: numerous cells with strong cytoplasmic positivity (consistent with IgM) in the mantle zone and interfollicular area, with concentric 'onion-skin' arrangement
C: weak, diffuse background staining without distinct positive cells (consistent with kappa light chain negativity)
D: strong cytoplasmic positivity in many mantle zone and interfollicular cells (consistent with lambda light chain)
Regressed germinal center with concentric mantle zone visible in all panels
15140.describe_en: Composite lymph node immunohistochemistry from HIV-associated multicentric Castleman disease. Panel A shows nuclear, stippled positivity in scattered large plasmablasts concentrated in the mantle zone around an atrophic germinal center, consistent with HHV8 LANA-1. Panels B and D show numerous plasmablasts and plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic staining in the concentrically arranged mantle zone and interfollicular region, whereas panel C shows only weak background staining without distinct positive cells; this pattern is consistent with the characteristic IgM-positive, lambda-restricted phenotype of HHV8-positive MCD plasmablasts, although the specific antibodies per panel are not labeled in the image. Despite light-chain restriction, these plasmablasts are typically polyclonal by molecular studies, and they are EBV (EBER)-negative, distinguishing them from plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: In HHV8+ DLBCL the LANA-1-positive, IgM-lambda plasmablasts form confluent sheets effacing architecture rather than being confined to mantle zones.

ddx.dx: HHV8- and EBV-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: Germinotropic LPD shows LANA-1-positive plasmablasts within germinal centers that are EBER-positive and usually IgM-negative, rather than mantle zone plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: Idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease (plasma cell type)
ddx.vs: iMCD shows interfollicular polytypic plasma cells without LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.
Plasmablastic lymphoma forms diffuse sheets that are EBER-positive, CD20-negative and LANA-1-negative.

15140.stain: IHC: HHV8 LANA-1 (A); IHC: likely IgM, kappa, lambda (B-D)
captions: A: LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone
B: Strong cytoplasmic immunoglobulin staining in mantle zone cells
D: Strong cytoplasmic light-chain staining in mantle zone cells

13220.recognize_zh: 單顆中性球的核分成遠多於 5 葉（約 8 葉以上），各葉以細絲相連，細胞本身也偏大，是典型的過度分葉中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），提示維生素 B12 或葉酸缺乏造成的巨母細胞性造血。
features: Single neutrophil with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus (well over 5 lobes, approximately 8 or more)
Lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments, with dense clumped chromatin
Cell larger than a typical neutrophil (macropolycyte)
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; no toxic granulation or Döhle bodies
Surrounding red cells round with central pallor; overall red cell size cannot be reliably judged in this crop
13220.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus composed of more than 5 lobes joined by thin chromatin strands. The cytoplasm contains fine neutrophilic granules without toxic granulation or Döhle bodies. The adjacent red cells are not diagnostic on their own in this high-power field. A neutrophil with 6 or more lobes (or more than 5% of neutrophils with 5 lobes) is suggestive of megaloblastic hematopoiesis, most commonly due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency; correlation with MCV, serum B12/folate, methylmalonic acid, and homocysteine is recommended.

ddx.vs: The hereditary form is a benign autosomal dominant trait without macrocytosis or anemia, so it is separated by normal B12/folate and family studies.
Drug effect gives the same hypersegmentation and is distinguished by medication history rather than morphology.
MDS more often shows hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) and hypogranular neutrophils with cytopenias, with normal vitamin levels and clonal cytogenetic changes.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or renal failure–associated hypersegmentation
ddx.vs: These may show mild hypersegmentation with microcytosis or normocytosis rather than macro-ovalocytes.

3108.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有兩顆大型細胞，淡灰紫色胞質豐富且邊界圓滑，核卵圓、染色質細緻，比周圍的淋巴球與顆粒球前驅細胞大數倍，呈現增生組織球（reactive histiocytes）的樣子。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant, pale gray-lilac, finely granular to slightly vacuolated cytoplasm and smooth round outlines
Oval, eccentric nuclei with finely reticular chromatin and no prominent nucleoli
Low N:C ratio with ill-defined outer cytoplasmic margins
Background of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells
No ingested blood cells or organisms evident
3108.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm and oval eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No phagocytosed cells, pigment or organisms are identified within these cells. The background contains small lymphocytes, granulocytic precursors and erythroid elements without increased blasts. Findings are consistent with reactive histiocytes; clinical correlation for infection, inflammation or hemophagocytic syndrome is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytes contain engulfed erythrocytes, platelets or nucleated cells, which are not seen in these histiocytes.
Plasma cells are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin rather than abundant pale cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale Golgi zone set away from the nucleus and more basophilic cytoplasm, often in clusters.
Mast cells have cytoplasm packed with dark purple metachromatic granules obscuring the nucleus.

2916.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的正常造血組織被一片流線狀排列的細胞與纖維性間質取代；此倍率看不到節細胞（ganglion cells），需高倍確認化療後的分化。
features: Low-power core biopsy with bony trabeculae and hypercellular intertrabecular spaces
Marrow replaced by a streaming infiltrate of dark nuclei in pale fibrillary/fibrous stroma
No normal fat or trilineage hematopoiesis recognizable
Ganglion cells and cytologic detail cannot be resolved at this magnification
2916.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows trabecular bone with intertrabecular spaces diffusely replaced by an infiltrate of dark cells arranged in streaming, fascicle-like patterns within pale fibrillary to fibrotic stroma. Normal fat and trilineage hematopoiesis are not appreciated. Individual cell morphology, including ganglion cell differentiation, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by treated metastatic neuroblastoma with stromal changes; higher-power examination is needed to document ganglion cell differentiation.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis retains atypical clustered megakaryocytes and residual hematopoiesis rather than a streaming infiltrate of non-hematopoietic tumor cells.
Aplastic post-therapy marrow is hypocellular with edema and fat, whereas this marrow is densely cellular.
Low-power pattern cannot distinguish these; myogenin/desmin versus PHOX2B/synaptophysin immunostains are needed.

1252.recognize_zh: 成群的漿細胞具偏心圓核、核周淡染區與藍色細胞質，細胞質內充滿紫紅色、細長針狀的包涵物（Auer rod-like inclusions），部分細胞核可見核仁，是顆粒豐富的骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of medium to large plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; some nuclei show a visible nucleolus (immature/plasmablastic features)
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in several cells
Numerous slender, needle- or rod-shaped azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods
Occasional binucleate plasma cell; background red cells and a neutrophil
1252.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, moderately coarse chromatin, occasional nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Many cells contain numerous slender azurophilic rod-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions that mimic Auer rods, likely representing crystallized immunoglobulin or abnormal lysosomal granules. The cells retain plasmacytic features (eccentric nucleus, perinuclear hof) and lack myeloblast morphology. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Auer rod-like cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and no perinuclear hof, and are MPO-positive, whereas these cells are CD138-positive plasma cells.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei with bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) and strong MPO, not eccentric nuclei with plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Crystals in CSH lie within histiocytes with bland oval nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm rather than within plasma cells.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells are macrophages with wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm, not plasma cells with discrete rod inclusions.

1124.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆巨大巨噬細胞內滿是數百個大小一致的小卵圓形酵母菌，各有偏心的紫色新月形核與清亮暈圈，沒有動基體（kinetoplast），符合莢膜組織漿菌感染。
features: Large macrophage packed with hundreds of small, uniform oval organisms (2-4 µm)
Organisms with crescentic eccentric purple staining and a clear surrounding halo
No kinetoplast identified in the organisms
Macrophage cytoplasm pale and foamy; host nuclei displaced
Some organisms free in the background from ruptured cells
1124.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a large macrophage filled with hundreds of small, uniform, oval yeast forms, each with an eccentric crescent of purple nuclear material and a clear halo. No kinetoplasts are identified, and scattered free organisms are present adjacent to the cell. The findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection (disseminated histoplasmosis); fungal stains, culture and urine/serum antigen testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a distinct bar-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and lack a clear halo.
Talaromyces organisms are more elongated with central transverse septa from fission, seen in patients with Southeast Asian exposure.
Superimposed platelets are granular and irregular without a crisp nucleus-halo structure and are not confined within the cytoplasm.

1060.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑增厚且層狀紋路明顯，小樑間的骨髓腔被淡染、空泡狀的細胞取代，幾乎看不到正常造血細胞；需要PSA或NKX3.1免疫染色確認是否為轉移性前列腺癌。
features: Thickened bony trabeculae with prominent lamellar and cement lines, suggesting reactive new bone formation
Intertrabecular space replaced by pale, vacuolated/clear cells with small dark nuclei
Loss of normal hematopoietic elements in the involved space
Carcinoma glandular architecture not clearly resolved at this magnification
Residual marrow cells visible in the adjacent space at the left edge
1060.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy section shows thickened trabeculae with prominent lamellar lines, consistent with osteosclerotic change. The intertrabecular space is replaced by a population of pale, vacuolated cells with small hyperchromatic nuclei, with loss of normal hematopoiesis. Definite glandular differentiation or cytologic atypia is difficult to confirm at this magnification. In the clinical context, findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by metastatic carcinoma with osteoblastic reaction; confirmation with keratin and prostatic markers (PSA, NKX3.1) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Serous atrophy shows extracellular pale pink-blue gelatinous material with fat atrophy and is Alcian blue positive and keratin negative.
RCC also forms clear cells but typically produces lytic lesions and is PAX8/CAIX positive rather than PSA/NKX3.1 positive.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with fibrovascular marrow but no epithelial cells, which would be keratin negative.

4196.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指兩個紅血球淡染（低色素），細胞質中佈滿大小不一的藍色點狀顆粒，即嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling）；背景有許多標靶細胞與低色素小紅血球，提示血紅素疾病（如地中海型貧血）。
features: Two pale, hypochromic RBCs (arrows) with fine-to-coarse blue punctate granules evenly distributed through the cell (basophilic stippling)
Numerous target cells (codocytes) in the background
Hypochromic microcytes and occasional teardrop/irregular poikilocytes
RBC with a central refractile inclusion-like body (likely artifact/overlying platelet)
Scattered platelets; no leukocytes in field
4196.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous target cells and hypochromic microcytes. Two pale red cells contain numerous fine to coarse, evenly distributed basophilic granules consistent with basophilic stippling, representing aggregated ribosomal RNA. Scattered platelets are present. Findings of basophilic stippling with prominent target cells and hypochromia are suggestive of a hemoglobin disorder such as thalassemia; lead poisoning and pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency are other causes to consider, and hemoglobin analysis and lead level are recommended as appropriate.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few small clustered granules at the cell periphery and stain with Prussian blue, whereas stippling is numerous and diffusely distributed.
A Howell-Jolly body is a single larger round dense DNA remnant rather than many fine blue dots.
Polychromatophilic cells have uniform bluish-gray tint without discrete granules on Wright stain.
Parasites show ring structures with chromatin dots and cytoplasm, not diffuse punctate dots.

4068.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量小到中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質少而深藍，核圓、染色質中度凝集，部分可見單一明顯核仁（前淋巴球樣），並夾雜少數粒系與紅系前驅細胞，符合 T-PLL；但須以流式與 TCL1 確認系別。
features: Numerous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; a subset with a single visible nucleolus
Scant to moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, occasionally with small blebs
Admixed larger cells with fine chromatin and moderate blue cytoplasm, a few maturing myeloid cells and orthochromatic erythroid precursors
Background RBCs with some overlap/rouleaux in thick area
4068.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen dominated by small-to-medium lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, frequently a single visible nucleolus, and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Scattered larger mononuclear cells, maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors are admixed. Morphology alone cannot reliably separate these prolymphocyte-like cells from other lymphoid neoplasms. Findings are compatible with involvement by T-prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD4+/CD8± T cells, CD7 bright) and TCL1 expression or TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / prolymphocytic progression of CLL
ddx.vs: B-lineage prolymphocytes look similar but are CD19/CD20+ with strong sIg by flow and lack TCL1A rearrangement.
MCL cells have irregular cleaved nuclei and are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive B cells.
ATLL cells show polylobated flower nuclei without prominent nucleoli and are CD25+/HTLV-1 associated.
Blasts have finer chromatin, are TdT- or CD34-positive, and lack the condensed chromatin of mature prolymphocytes.

4132.recognize_zh: 藍紫色的白髓淋巴組織包圍一條管壁厚、粉紅色的中央小動脈（central arteriole），形成動脈周圍淋巴鞘（PALS），外圍是充血的紅髓，是正常脾臟白髓的結構。
features: White pulp nodule of small mature lymphocytes surrounding an eccentric central arteriole with a thick pink wall
Periarteriolar lymphoid sheath without a prominent germinal center
Subtle paler rim at the periphery corresponding to marginal zone
Surrounding red pulp with congested cords and sinusoids containing red cells and mixed leukocytes
No atypical large cells, granulomas or infiltrates evident
4132.describe_en: Section of spleen shows a white pulp nodule composed of small mature lymphocytes arranged around a thick-walled central arteriole, forming the periarteriolar lymphoid sheath, with an indistinct paler marginal zone. The surrounding red pulp shows congested cords and sinusoids with scattered mixed inflammatory cells. There is no expansion of the white pulp, cytologic atypia, or abnormal infiltrate. Findings are consistent with normal splenic white and red pulp.

ddx.vs: Features expanded, often confluent nodules with a prominent pale marginal zone of monocytoid cells and red pulp infiltration, confirmed by clonality studies.
Shows enlarged germinal centers with tingible body macrophages and polarization, not present here.
Lymph nodes have a capsule with subcapsular sinus and cortex/medulla organization instead of arteriole-centered lymphoid sheaths within blood-filled red pulp.

4004.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血中並排可見核摺疊、細胞質灰藍的單核球與不成熟單核細胞，以及核分葉異常的嗜中性球；兒童單核球系列增生合併顆粒球異形變化，符合幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Monocytes with convoluted, ring-like or folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Round mononuclear cell with coarse clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (immature monocyte or lymphocyte)
Neutrophil with abnormally segmented, clumped nuclear lobes and hypogranular cytoplasm
Red cells with stomatocyte-like central pallor and occasional elongated forms
Small platelet fragments in background; no blasts identified
4004.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows several myelomonocytic cells in a row: monocytes with folded or ring-shaped nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, a round mononuclear cell with clumped chromatin, and a neutrophil with irregular clumped lobes and reduced granulation. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with monocytosis with dysplastic granulocytic features, suggestive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in a young child.

ddx.vs: CMML shows the same monocytosis and granulocytic dysplasia but affects older adults, so patient age and genetics separate it from JMML.
Reactive monocytes lack accompanying granulocytic dysplasia and the persistent monocytosis, splenomegaly and RAS-pathway mutations of JMML.
Morphology is indistinguishable; the germline PTPN11 status and spontaneous resolution in infancy distinguish it from JMML.

3940.recognize_zh: 兒童骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，以各階段成熟中的顆粒球（前骨髓球、骨髓球、後骨髓球）為主，夾雜小淋巴球與晚期有核紅血球，沒有單一型態的母細胞群，屬反應性骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by maturing granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Myeloid cells show orderly maturation with azurophilic to specific granules and no Auer rods
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and occasional hematogone-like cells with scant cytoplasm
Late (orthochromatic) erythroid precursors with dense pyknotic nuclei
No monotonous blast population; background red cells with drying artifact
3940.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a predominance of granulocytic precursors with an orderly progression through promyelocyte, myelocyte, metamyelocyte, and band stages. Scattered small lymphocytes and late erythroid precursors are present. No Auer rods, monotonous blast population, or significant dysplasia is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a reactive marrow with myeloid hyperplasia in a pediatric patient; correlation with differential count and clinical history (infection, recovery) is recommended.

ddx.vs: AML shows a monotonous population of blasts (typically >=20%) with fine chromatin, nucleoli, and possibly Auer rods, rather than orderly full-spectrum maturation.
ALL replaces the marrow with uniform lymphoblasts, whereas hematogones are few and show a maturational spectrum on flow cytometry.
CML shows marked myeloid hyperplasia with basophilia, eosinophilia, and small megakaryocytes, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
JMML shows monocytosis, dysplasia, and RAS-pathway mutations rather than a simple granulocytic left shift.

3748.recognize_zh: 這顆嗜中性球細胞質布滿粗大、深紫紅色的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），核呈兩葉，是使用 G-CSF 後常見的中性球變化。
features: Neutrophil of normal size with a bilobed nucleus and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm filled with coarse, dark purple-red (azurophilic) granules consistent with toxic granulation
Faint pale blue cytoplasmic areas, possibly early Döhle bodies
No cytoplasmic vacuolation evident
Background normocytic red cells with central pallor and occasional platelets
3748.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus and prominent coarse, dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granules consistent with toxic granulation. Cytoplasmic vacuoles are not seen, and the red cells are normocytic and normochromic. In a patient receiving growth factor, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect; infection or inflammation can produce identical changes.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; clinical history of G-CSF administration versus infection is the discriminator.
Alder-Reilly granules are constitutional, present in all leukocyte types including lymphocytes, and not accompanied by Döhle bodies.
Dysplastic hypolobated neutrophils usually show hypogranular cytoplasm and clumped chromatin rather than increased coarse granules.

3364.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型組織球，細胞質充滿大小一致的透明空泡（泡沫狀），其中一顆含棕褐與藍綠色色素，周圍為各階段造血細胞，符合骨髓組織球增多（泡沫/含色素組織球）。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with uniform clear vacuoles (foamy appearance)
One histiocyte contains coarse brown to blue-green pigment consistent with hemosiderin/ceroid
Histiocyte nuclei small, round, eccentric, bland
Cellular background of maturing erythroid precursors, myeloid cells, lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells
Scattered eosinophilic myelocytes; no blasts increase evident
3364.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis, including maturing erythroid precursors, granulocytic cells and scattered lymphocytes and plasma cells. Several large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm filled with uniform clear vacuoles are present; one contains coarse brown and blue-green pigment. The histiocytes have small bland nuclei and no organisms are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow histiocytosis with foamy and pigment-laden histiocytes; correlation with iron stain, lipid profile, storage disease work-up and clinical context is recommended.

ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick foam cells show the same soap-bubble vacuolation but occur as numerous cells with confirmatory sphingomyelinase deficiency or NPC1/NPC2 mutations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain abundant blue-green granular ceroid on Romanowsky stain rather than predominantly clear vacuoles.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crinkled blue-gray cytoplasm without discrete round vacuoles.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain intact engulfed erythrocytes, nucleated cells or platelets rather than lipid vacuoles.

3428.recognize_zh: 較高倍下多顆中型非典型淋巴細胞，核形不規則、有凹陷或切跡（部分呈裂隙狀），染色質細緻中度濃縮，細胞質少量淡藍，符合周邊血液化濾泡性淋巴瘤中非典型（偏大）的腫瘤細胞。
features: Numerous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, roughly 1.5–2 times red cell diameter
Nuclei irregular with indentations, notches and occasional deep clefts
Chromatin finely clumped to moderately condensed; small nucleoli faintly visible in a few cells
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm, sometimes with slightly irregular borders
Background normocytic red cells; one small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
3428.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous atypical intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, notched and focally cleaved nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm. The cells are larger and less uniform than classic small cleaved follicular lymphoma cells, and compare with an adjacent small mature lymphocyte. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoma cells of follicular lymphoma with atypical morphology; flow cytometry for a CD10-positive clonal B-cell population and BCL2 rearrangement studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL shows comparable irregular nuclei, so CD5 positivity, cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14) are required for distinction.
SMZL cells have round nuclei with polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are CD10 negative.
Prolymphocytes have round nuclei with a single prominent central nucleolus rather than cleaved nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes form a heterogeneous spectrum with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and are polyclonal.

3172.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有標靶紅血球，並見數個含有棱角狀、指套或船形結晶的紅血球（SC crystal），部分細胞有直線折痕，偶見卵圓形紅血球，符合血紅素SC病。
features: Several red cells with angular, dense intraerythrocytic crystals or blunt, finger-like projections (SC cells)
Folded red cells with straight crease lines and dense angular cells
Target cells and cells with irregular central hemoglobin distribution
Occasional ovalocytes and a crenated (echinocytic) cell
No classic elongated sickle cells in the field
3172.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered target cells together with red cells containing dense, angular hemoglobin crystals and folded cells with straight crease lines. Occasional ovalocytes and a crenated cell are noted. Typical elongated sickle cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease; confirmation by hemoglobin HPLC or electrophoresis is recommended.

ddx.vs: HbC crystals are hexagonal or rod-shaped 'bar of gold' crystals within otherwise empty cells, whereas SC crystals are blunt, finger-like or glove-shaped, and HPLC distinguishes by the absence of HbS.
HbSS has abundant thin crescent-shaped sickle cells rather than dense angular crystal-containing cells and target cells.

ddx.dx: Red cell overlap or drying artifact
ddx.vs: Artifactual folds are seen in thick areas and lack dense hemoglobin concentrated in crystal-like shapes.

2980.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間幾乎沒有脂肪、細胞密度很高，細胞間夾雜淡粉紅色較鬆散的區域；此倍率看不到巨大顆粒，無法單憑此圖確認 Chediak-Higashi 症候群。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absent fat between trabeculae
Mixed hematopoietic population with scattered interstitial eosinophilic, loosely cellular areas
Focal hemorrhage/erythrocyte extravasation
Bony trabeculae unremarkable
Granule morphology not resolvable at this magnification
2980.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat spaces. The intertrabecular space is filled by a mixed hematopoietic population with patchy, looser eosinophilic areas and focal hemorrhage. Cytoplasmic giant granules cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are nonspecific; in the clinical context of Chediak-Higashi syndrome, a hypercellular marrow may reflect ineffective granulopoiesis or an accelerated (HLH-like) phase, to be confirmed on aspirate and high-power examination.

ddx.vs: HLH shows increased histiocytes with hemophagocytosis on high power and aspirate, and CD163 IHC; genetic testing distinguishes familial forms from CHS.
Clonal disorders show atypical megakaryocytes, dysplasia or fibrosis, and cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities rather than giant granules.
Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation with normal granules on aspirate.

2852.recognize_zh: 瀰漫一致的中型淋巴樣細胞，核形略不規則、染色質較細緻偏母細胞樣，其間穿插小血管與粉紅色玻璃樣物質，這種單調排列提示套細胞淋巴瘤（母細胞樣變異型）。
features: Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells
Slightly irregular to angulated nuclei with relatively fine, dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli; scant cytoplasm
Scattered small vessels and pink hyalinized material/erythrocytes between cells
No follicular architecture, no large centroblasts/immunoblasts admixed
2852.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse proliferation of monotonous, medium-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclear contours, relatively fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Small vessels with pink hyalinized walls and extravasated erythrocytes are interspersed. Admixed centroblasts, paraimmunoblasts or proliferation centers are not identified. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid features; confirmation with cyclin D1/SOX11 immunostains and Ki-67 is required.

ddx.vs: Classic MCL has smaller cells with more condensed chromatin and a lower proliferation index, whereas blastoid MCL shows fine blast-like chromatin and a high Ki-67.
TdT positivity and lack of cyclin D1 separate lymphoblastic lymphoma from blastoid MCL.
SLL shows round nuclei with clumped chromatin and pale proliferation centers containing prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts, and is LEF1+/cyclin D1-negative.
FL contains cleaved centrocytes admixed with centroblasts and is CD10+/BCL2+ with t(14;18), cyclin D1-negative.

2724.recognize_zh: 高倍下單一母細胞：核佔細胞大部分、染色質細緻均勻、核輪廓略凹，細胞質少呈淡藍並有一個小空泡；此張看不到明確的嗜天青顆粒或 Auer 小體，只能確認為母細胞，顆粒特徵需參考同系列其他圖。
features: Single blast about twice the diameter of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with a slightly indented nuclear contour
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
Narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm with a single small clear vacuole
No definite azurophilic granules or Auer rods visible in this image
