2724.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a single blast with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a slightly indented nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and indistinct nucleoli, and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing a small vacuole. Definite azurophilic granules and Auer rods are not seen in this cell. The morphology is that of a blast but does not by itself demonstrate the granular feature of granular ALL. Findings are compatible with a lymphoblast in the context of granular ALL; lineage must be confirmed by MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often have more visible nucleoli and may contain Auer rods; MPO positivity and myeloid antigens distinguish them.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple lipid vacuoles, rather than a single vacuole in pale cytoplasm.
Hematogones have more homogeneous, smudgy condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and are a benign maturing population by flow cytometry.

2404.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的顆粒周圍除了大量正常大小的造血細胞外，散布數顆明顯較大、深藍色細胞質的細胞，中央一顆最醒目；低倍下先找出「體積大、藍色細胞質」的細胞再放大確認為不典型漿細胞。
features: Low-power view of a cellular aspirate particle with fat vacuoles
Scattered conspicuously large cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm, one prominent near the center
Background of numerous smaller maturing myeloid and erythroid cells
Cellular detail (nucleoli, hof) cannot be assessed at this magnification
Dense, poorly spread particle at upper right
2404.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with fat vacuoles and a mixed background of maturing hematopoietic cells. Scattered large cells with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm stand out against the smaller hematopoietic cells, the most conspicuous near the center of the field. Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification, so higher-power review is needed to confirm plasma cell morphology. In the clinical context, these cells are compatible with large atypical plasma cells of plasma cell myeloma; plasma cell enumeration and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: At higher power megakaryocytes show lobulated nuclei and granular pink-lilac cytoplasm rather than deep blue cytoplasm with a round eccentric nucleus.
Osteoblasts cluster in sheets and osteoclasts are multinucleated with separate uniform nuclei, and neither expresses clonal light chains.
Metastatic cells form cohesive three-dimensional clumps, often at the smear edge, rather than dispersed single large cells.

2276.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量母細胞（細緻染色質、核仁、藍色細胞質），同時可見帶嗜天青顆粒的前骨髓細胞與骨髓細胞等成熟中的顆粒球，顯示母細胞增加但仍有向顆粒球分化，符合伴成熟的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Increased myeloblasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Some blasts with scattered azurophilic granules
Admixed maturing granulocytes: promyelocytes and myelocytes with granular cytoplasm and occasional clear perinuclear hof
Occasional cells with irregular or indented nuclei
Background red cells and scattered free granules; no definite Auer rods resolved at this resolution
2276.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population of myeloblasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some containing azurophilic granules. Admixed are maturing granulocytic cells, including promyelocytes and myelocytes, indicating maturation beyond the blast stage. Auer rods are not definitively resolved at this image resolution. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, pending blast enumeration and cytogenetic studies to exclude RUNX1::RUNX1T1 and other defining genetic abnormalities.

ddx.vs: In AML without maturation, maturing granulocytes (promyelocyte onward) comprise less than 10% of nonerythroid cells.
t(8;21) blasts often show abundant salmon-colored cytoplasm with perinuclear hof, long slender Auer rods and pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules, and require cytogenetics to confirm.
APL is dominated by abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells rather than blasts with a maturation spectrum.
MDS has fewer than 20% blasts with multilineage dysplasia.

2212.recognize_zh: 大型芽細胞染色質細緻、核仁可見，細胞質藍色並含多少不等的嗜天青顆粒，部分有核旁淡染區（hof）與較多粗顆粒，顯示芽細胞帶有向早幼粒分化的成熟跡象，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Large myeloblasts with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with variable fine azurophilic granules
Some cells with more abundant coarse granules and paranuclear hof (promyelocyte-like maturation)
Round to oval nuclei, some slightly indented
Auer rods not clearly identified in this field
2212.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts contain fine azurophilic granules, and several cells show more abundant granulation with a paranuclear clearing, indicating maturation toward the promyelocyte stage. Auer rods are not definitively seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, provided blasts are ≥20% with ≥10% maturing granulocytic cells; cytogenetic evaluation for RUNX1::RUNX1T1 is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or reniform nuclei with heavy granulation or bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) and PML::RARA.
AML without maturation has <10% maturing granulocytic cells, whereas granulated promyelocyte-like maturation is evident here.
Often morphologically similar with salmon-colored hofs, long slender Auer rods and pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules; defined by cytogenetics.
Recovering marrow shows orderly maturation with promyelocytes lacking a blast excess and resolves over time.

2148.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞量高，顆粒球系各階段細胞增生，並夾雜許多核呈折疊或腎形、胞質灰藍的單核球樣細胞，芽細胞不占多數，呈現骨髓系與單核球系混合增生的外觀，需搭配周邊血單核球增多才能診斷 CMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate particle area with myeloid predominance
Numerous granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Admixed monocytoid cells with folded to reniform nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Blasts present but not predominant
Scattered erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes; fat vacuoles in background
2148.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at medium power is hypercellular with a myeloid predominance showing granulocytic maturation through all stages. Numerous admixed monocytoid cells with folded or reniform nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm are present, whereas blasts are not increased to an acute leukemia range in this field. Dysplasia cannot be reliably graded at this magnification. The findings of granulocytic and monocytic proliferation are compatible with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in the setting of persistent peripheral monocytosis (≥0.5 × 10^9/L and ≥10% of WBC).

ddx.vs: CML shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes and is defined by BCR::ABL1, whereas CMML lacks BCR::ABL1 and has monocytosis.
aCML shows marked granulocytic dysplasia with <10% monocytes, whereas CMML has ≥10% peripheral monocytes.
Reactive states lack dysplasia and clonal markers (e.g., TET2, SRSF2, ASXL1 mutations) and resolve with the underlying cause.
AMML requires ≥20% blasts plus promonocytes, which exceeds the blast count seen here.

1956.recognize_zh: 極低倍下淋巴結實質被瀰漫而均一的浸潤佔滿，看不到正常濾泡結構，下方被膜下方有較深染的淋巴球帶；解析度有限，只能看出結構破壞的整體樣貌。
features: Diffuse, fairly monotonous-appearing effacement of lymph node parenchyma at very low power
No recognizable reactive follicles
Thin capsule at the bottom with a darker band of small lymphocytes beneath it
Vague pale areas within the infiltrate; cytologic and vascular detail not resolvable
1956.describe_en: Very low-power section of a lymph node shows diffuse effacement of the parenchyma by a cellular infiltrate without identifiable reactive follicles. A thin capsule is present at the bottom, with a subjacent darker band of small lymphocytes. Resolution is insufficient to evaluate sinus patency, vascular proliferation, or cytologic features. Findings are compatible with a diffuse nodal lymphoma and, in context, with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; higher-power histology and immunophenotyping are required.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS also effaces the node but lacks the TFH phenotype, arborizing HEVs, and expanded perivascular FDC meshworks of AITL.
DLBCL is composed of sheets of large CD20-positive B cells rather than a polymorphous infiltrate of TFH-phenotype T cells.
Reactive nodes preserve follicles and sinuses on low power, which are not seen here.

1764.recognize_zh: 淋巴結H&E切片中，被膜下方的被膜下竇被大量大型、細胞質豐富且核仁明顯的腫瘤細胞填滿，呈竇內浸潤，是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤常見的分布模式。
features: Lymph node capsule and perinodal loose connective tissue at top
Subcapsular sinus distended by sheets of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large vesicular nuclei with visible nucleoli, including irregular and reniform forms
Admixed smaller dark lymphocytes, more numerous toward the deeper node
Cohesive-appearing sinusoidal growth that mimics metastatic carcinoma
1764.describe_en: Lymph node section shows the capsule with an expanded subcapsular sinus filled by sheets of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes. The sinusoidal distribution and cohesive appearance mimic metastatic carcinoma. High-power nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma with sinusoidal involvement; CD30, ALK, and keratin immunostains are recommended.

ddx.vs: Metastases also favor subcapsular sinuses but are keratin or SOX10/S100 positive and CD30 negative.
Sinus histiocytes have bland small oval nuclei and pale foamy cytoplasm without nucleolar atypia, and are CD68/CD163 positive.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets of large cells within sinuses.

1700.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿是圓形母細胞，大小不一（中央一顆特大），核質比高、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，細胞質少量淡藍無顆粒；背景小藍色團塊為血小板。系別需靠流式判定。
features: Blasts of variable size, including one conspicuously large central blast
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and smooth nuclear contours
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Thin rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Background with scattered platelet clumps and a single red cell
1700.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of round blasts that vary from medium to large in size. They have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, smooth round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods, granules and maturing myeloid cells are not seen in this field; background platelets are present. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia, and lineage determination (including mixed-phenotype acute leukemia) requires immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Size heterogeneity and agranular cytoplasm overlap completely; lineage is established by flow cytometry (CD19/CD79a/CD10 or cCD3) with absent MPO.
Some blasts would contain fine azurophilic granules or Auer rods and show MPO positivity in at least 3% of blasts.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and a mature B (sIg-positive, TdT-negative) phenotype, unlike these pale agranular blasts.

1444.recognize_zh: 兩格周邊血抹片：紅血球多為偏大的卵圓形（oval macrocytes）、中央淡染區不明顯，血小板數量不減少，白血球稀少（左為小淋巴球、右為嗜中性球），呈現 5q- 症候群常見的巨球性貧血伴血小板正常。
features: Red cells predominantly oval, with many macro-ovalocytes and reduced central pallor
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop and irregular forms
Platelets present in normal to mildly increased numbers without marked giant forms
Leukocytes sparse: a small mature lymphocyte (left panel) and a segmented neutrophil (right panel)
No circulating blasts or nucleated red cells in these fields
1444.describe_en: Two fields of a peripheral blood smear are shown. Red cells show macrocytosis with numerous oval macrocytes and mild anisopoikilocytosis, including rare teardrop forms. Platelets are adequate to mildly increased in number, and leukocytes are sparse, represented by a small lymphocyte and a segmented neutrophil; no blasts are seen. Macrocytic anemia with preserved or increased platelet count is the typical blood picture of myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q), and the findings are consistent with that diagnosis pending marrow and karyotype correlation.

ddx.vs: Shows oval macrocytes plus hypersegmented neutrophils and often thrombocytopenia, and corrects with vitamin replacement.
Platelets are markedly increased with giant forms and red cells are normocytic, and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations are present.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Features dimorphic red cells with marked thrombocytosis and ring sideroblasts with SF3B1 mutation, distinguished by iron stain and genetics.
Morphology overlaps; isolated del(5q) on karyotype and non-lobated megakaryocytes in marrow define the entity.

100.recognize_zh: 淋巴結正常結構被瀰漫性小至中型淋巴球浸潤取代，只殘留少數濾泡（CD20 標出殘存濾泡）；T 細胞標記在濾泡間區呈瀰漫陽性，EBER 原位雜交在大量浸潤細胞核呈陽性，流式顯示 CD8 優勢（CD4:CD8 倒置），加上兒童臨床背景，指向全身性 EBV 陽性 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Low power: lymph node architecture largely effaced by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate with only a few residual follicles pushed toward the periphery

High power: sheets of small to intermediate lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei and mild atypia, admixed with scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin, histiocytes and eosinophilic debris
IHC: diffuse strong staining of the interfollicular infiltrate for T-cell markers with sparing of residual follicles; one marker stains only a subset of cells
CD20-type stain highlights discrete residual B-cell follicles; a second stain shows nuclear positivity confined to follicle centers
EBER ISH: numerous positive nuclei (dark blue-purple signal) throughout the infiltrate
Flow cytometry of lymphocytes: CD8+ 51.13%, CD4+ 26.59%, CD4/CD8 double-negative 21.28% (inverted CD4:CD8 ratio)
100.describe_en: Lymph node excision shows near-total effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse infiltrate, with scattered residual follicles at the periphery. At high power the infiltrate is composed of small to intermediate lymphocytes with mildly irregular nuclei, admixed with scattered larger cells and histiocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse interfollicular staining for T-cell markers that spares the residual follicles, while a B-cell stain highlights the residual follicles; the individual stains are not labeled in the figure, so antigen-specific loss (such as the reported CD5 downregulation) cannot be confirmed from the images alone. EBER in situ hybridization is positive in numerous infiltrating cells, and flow cytometry shows a CD8-predominant T-cell population with an inverted CD4:CD8 ratio and a sizable CD4/CD8 double-negative fraction. In the setting of a child with systemic EBV infection, clonal TCR rearrangement and multifocal nodal and splenic disease, findings are consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood.

ddx.vs: IM shows a polymorphous, predominantly B-immunoblastic EBER-positive population with preserved sinuses, polyclonal TCR and no sheets of EBER-positive monotonous T cells.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease, T-cell type
ddx.vs: CAEBV has EBER-positive T/NK cells but a less monotonous infiltrate without architectural effacement and a longer indolent course; the distinction relies on clinical tempo and clonality context.
EBV-HLH shows prominent hemophagocytosis and fewer EBER-positive T cells without a destructive monotonous nodal infiltrate, though the two overlap and can coexist.

ENKTL is typically extranodal and angiocentric with necrosis, expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD56 with cytotoxic markers and usually lacks TCR rearrangement, unlike this clonal surface CD3+ nodal T-cell process.

100.stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled markers); ISH: EBER; flow cytometry
captions: H&E lymph node: A, low power with diffuse effacement and residual peripheral follicles; B, high power with small to intermediate atypical lymphocytes and histiocytes
IHC (markers unlabeled): A-C, diffuse interfollicular staining sparing residual follicles; D, positivity in a subset of infiltrating cells
A, B-cell stain highlighting residual follicles; B, nuclear stain restricted to follicle centers; C, EBER ISH positive in numerous infiltrating cells
Flow cytometry of lymphocytes: CD8+ 51.13%, CD4+ 26.59%, double-negative 21.28%, with inverted CD4:CD8 ratio

36.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿大型單核球系母細胞：細胞核圓形至折疊/腎形，染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質豐富、灰藍色帶細小嗜天青顆粒（monoblast/promonocyte），這種單核球分化型態常見於 KMT2A 重組的 AML，例如 t(9;11)。
features: Large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and occasional vacuoles
Round to folded, indented or reniform nuclei with delicate lacy chromatin and one or more nucleoli (monoblasts and promonocytes)
Aspirate markedly hypercellular with sheets of monocytic blasts and few maturing granulocytes
Peripheral blood with a circulating blast showing fine chromatin and scant blue cytoplasm
Core biopsy field (limited) shows loose edematous/fatty stroma adjacent to bone with scattered mononuclear cells having folded nuclei
No Auer rods identified in the images
36.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is hypercellular and composed predominantly of large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, consistent with monoblasts and promonocytes; residual granulocytic maturation is sparse and Auer rods are not seen. The core biopsy field shown contains loose stroma with scattered mononuclear cells with folded nuclei and is of limited diagnostic value on its own. Cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase) or flow cytometry for monocytic markers and karyotype are required for classification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, which in this case harbors t(9;11)(p21.3;q23.3); KMT2A::MLLT3.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: Often shows similar monocytic blasts with cup-like nuclear invaginations and is separated by molecular testing (NPM1 mutation, cytoplasmic NPM1) rather than morphology.
Bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with dust-like granules and faggot cells, strong MPO, CD34/HLA-DR negativity and PML::RARA distinguish it from these NSE-positive monoblasts.
Consists mainly of mature monocytes with dysplasia and fewer than 20% blasts plus promonocytes, unlike the sheets of monoblasts and promonocytes here.
Monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin and no nucleoli, without increased monoblasts or promonocytes.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating blast with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Bone marrow aspirate: sheets of monocytic blasts with folded nuclei and granular grey-blue cytoplasm
High power: cluster of monoblasts and promonocytes with fine chromatin and nucleoli beside a neutrophil
Core biopsy: loose stroma adjacent to bone with scattered mononuclear cells with folded nuclei

2340.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆受感染的紅血球內有形狀不規則、伸展成變形蟲狀（ameboid）的藍色滋養體，並帶有棕色瘧色素顆粒，受感染紅血球有輕度增大；這種變形蟲樣滋養體符合間日瘧原蟲（Plasmodium vivax）。
features: Single infected red cell with an irregular, ameboid blue-staining trophozoite
Fine brownish malarial pigment (hemozoin) within the parasite
Parasite occupies a large portion of the red cell, with the host cell mildly enlarged and pale
Schüffner stippling not clearly resolved at this focus
Background of thick-area, overlapping uninfected red cells and scattered platelets
2340.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single infected red cell containing an irregular, ameboid trophozoite with blue cytoplasm and fine brown hemozoin pigment, occupying much of a mildly enlarged host cell. Schüffner stippling is not clearly resolved in this thick area of the smear. The remaining red cells are uninfected. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection; species confirmation on a thin film (enlarged red cells, Schüffner dots, all stages present) or by antigen/PCR testing and parasitemia quantification are recommended.

ddx.vs: P. ovale trophozoites are more compact within oval, fimbriated enlarged red cells, whereas P. vivax trophozoites are ameboid.
P. falciparum shows small delicate ring forms, often multiple per normal-sized red cell with appliqué forms and banana-shaped gametocytes, without enlarged host cells.
P. malariae shows compact band-form trophozoites in normal-sized or small red cells with coarse pigment.
An overlying platelet has granular purple content without a chromatin dot, blue parasite cytoplasm, or pigment, and a halo in the same focal plane.

3620.recognize_zh: 大小正常的紅血球內可見一個含約 12–16 個裂殖子、中央聚集深褐色瘧色素的成熟裂殖體，另有數個含瘧色素的成熟滋養體；感染紅血球不變大、無 Schüffner 小點，周邊血出現惡性瘧成熟型提示高原蟲量或重症。
features: Mature schizont with approximately 12–16 merozoites arranged around a central clump of dark brown hemozoin
Several pigmented mature trophozoites in other red cells, one within an elongated erythrocyte
Infected red cells normal in size without Schüffner stippling
Extracellular clumped parasite/merozoite material near the center
Background red cells normocytic with occasional teardrop forms
3620.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows multiple parasitized red cells. One erythrocyte contains a mature segmented schizont with approximately 12–16 merozoites surrounding a central clump of dark hemozoin pigment, and several other red cells contain pigmented mature trophozoites. Infected cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling, and a small extracellular parasite cluster is also seen. In the context of known infection, these findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum; the presence of mature pigmented forms in the circulation indicates high parasite burden and warrants percentage parasitemia quantification.

ddx.vs: P. vivax schizonts contain 12–24 merozoites in an enlarged red cell with Schüffner dots, whereas these host cells are normal-sized.
P. malariae schizonts have 6–12 merozoites arranged in a rosette and trophozoites form band shapes.
P. knowlesi mimics falciparum rings and malariae mature forms, and requires PCR in patients exposed in Southeast Asia.
Babesia lacks pigment and schizonts and may form tetrads.
